tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Every demo page sets it on body.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surface: panels, table wells, sticky table headers, the current tab.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on ground and panel.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: theses, field labels, table headers, notes, footers.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline: every 1px border, table row divider, tab bar underline.

tokens.name: dmg-4
tokens.usage: Brightest step of the blue ramp: page titles, headline figures, words in tables.

tokens.name: dmg-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and stage labels. Fails 4.5:1 on panel in Dark (4.32) as the source has it.

tokens.name: dmg-2
tokens.usage: Mid ramp step: chart fills, rule-depth shading.

tokens.name: dmg-1
tokens.usage: Darkest ramp step: the deepest fill in stream strips and charts.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: The accent: links, the current tab's label and its 2px inset top rule, emphasised numbers, inline code.

tokens.name: hot-soft
tokens.usage: Softer accent for markers and fills, not body text (Light is 3.1:1 on panel).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Amber signal: escape symbols, costly outcomes, the .bad state.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Green signal: an encoded word, a cheap outcome. Fails 4.5:1 in Dark (4.42 on ground) as the source has it.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Verse boundaries and other structural markers in decoded text.

tokens.name: chain
tokens.usage: The YLK1 link chain drawn across cells.

tokens.name: chapter-marker
tokens.usage: Chapter boundary underline, drawn as a 2-3px inset box-shadow.

tokens.name: verse-marker
tokens.usage: Verse boundary underline, drawn as a 2-3px inset box-shadow.

tokens.name: sym-esc
tokens.usage: RPR1 stream strip: an escaped literal. One hue per symbol kind.

tokens.name: sym-esc-lo
tokens.usage: Low end of the escape ramp. Computed from the source's oklab color-mix.

tokens.name: sym-esc-hi
tokens.usage: High end of the escape ramp. Computed from the source's oklab color-mix.

tokens.name: sym-word
tokens.usage: RPR1 stream strip: a dictionary word symbol.

tokens.name: sym-rule
tokens.usage: RPR1 stream strip: a Re-Pair rule symbol.

tokens.name: sym-rule-lo
tokens.usage: Low end of the rule ramp. Computed from the source's oklab color-mix.

tokens.name: sym-rule-hi
tokens.usage: High end of the rule ramp. Computed from the source's oklab color-mix.

tokens.name: sym-direct
tokens.usage: YLK1 cell: a direct entry, the quietest kind.

tokens.name: sym-delta
tokens.usage: YLK1 cell: a delta entry.

tokens.name: sym-delta-lo
tokens.usage: Low end of the delta ramp. Computed from the source's oklab color-mix.

tokens.name: sym-delta-hi
tokens.usage: High end of the delta ramp. Computed from the source's oklab color-mix.

tokens.name: sym-terminal
tokens.usage: YLK1 cell: a terminal, where a chain ends.

tokens.name: sym-shortcut
tokens.usage: YLK1 cell: a shortcut entry.

tokens.name: lcd
tokens.usage: The LCD glass. A physical colour: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: lcd-well
tokens.usage: The glass a shade down, behind the lit area. Physical: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: lcd-bezel
tokens.usage: The black frame the glass sits in, a source literal with no variable of its own. Physical: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: lcd-ink
tokens.usage: A lit segment on the glass. 8.3:1 on lcd. Physical: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: lcd-dim
tokens.usage: An unlit or printed label on the glass, 2.1:1 on lcd by design — never real text. Physical: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: case
tokens.usage: The device shell. Physical: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: case-edge
tokens.usage: The shell's lit edge, its 1px border. Physical: identical in both themes.

tokens.name: case-face
tokens.usage: The shell's top face, where its gradient starts. Physical: identical in both themes.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Set on body. Everything inherits it.

styles.name: micro-caps
styles.usage: Stat keys and small captions, uppercased in CSS.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: Search inputs. Number inputs use body-sm at 13px.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: A stat's value, with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The headline figure. The source sets clamp(30px, 7vw, 48px); this is its ceiling.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: h1. The source sets clamp(20px, 4.4vw, 34px); this is its ceiling.

styles.name: tab-label
styles.usage: A tab's name in the tab bar.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The eyebrow above a page title and the stage label above a section, uppercased in CSS. Stage labels use 0.1em.

spacing.note: The source declares no spacing variables. These steps are the padding and gap values its stylesheets actually use; the values are observed, the names are ours.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tab bar gap, tightest chip rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row gap in wrapping legends and term lists.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Swatch-to-label gap, small chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Readout padding, chip padding, tab padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The default gap: baseline rows, query bars, legend column gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Input padding, stage label bottom margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Panel padding, stat grid row gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Two-column grid gap.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Page gutter, stat grid column gap, device padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page top padding, section rhythm (sections use 34px).

radius.note: The source declares no radius variables. Every value here is one it uses literally; the names are ours.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The default, and by far the most common: panels, chips, inputs, bars, table wells, tab tops.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The LCD glass and the stream modal.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Occasional larger inset blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The black LCD frame around the glass.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: The device shell.

shadow.note: Every shadow the source uses literally. Hex is written out because the token reader drops var() inside a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: The device shell lifted off the page.

tokens.name: shadow-lcd-frame
tokens.usage: The black frame's well around the glass.

tokens.name: shadow-lcd-glass
tokens.usage: The glass's own edge and vignette.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: The stream modal.

tokens.name: shadow-tab-current
tokens.usage: The 2px accent rule marking the current tab.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky-head
tokens.usage: A sticky table header's bottom hairline, where a border would scroll away.
